name: Rango de Luminancia de Video
algorithm: Video Luma Range — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes video luminance range for forensic detection:

1. **Dynamic Range Análisis**: The luminance range (minimum to maximum luma values) is measured per frame. The method checks whether the content uses the expected luma range for the video standard (broadcast range 16-235 for BT.601/709, full range 0-255 for full-range content).

2. **Range Consistencia Check**: The luma range should be consistent across the frame and over time. The method detects regions with different effective dynamic ranges — composited deepfake faces may show different dynamic range (from the generator's output mapping) than the original background footage.

3. **Highlight/Shadow Clipping Análisis**: The behavior of highlights (near maximum luma) and shadows (near minimum luma) is analyzed. Natural camera capture produces characteristic clipping characteristics. AI generators may produce different highlight/shadow rendering — either clean clipping (missing the natural rolloff) or extended range (values the capture format shouldn't contain).

4. **Temporal Range Evolution**: Dynamic range typically remains stable within a scene. The method tracks luma range statistics over time — sudden range changes without corresponding scene changes indicate processing artifacts.

5. **Gamma/Transfer Function Análisis**: The effective transfer function (gamma curve) is estimated from the luma distribution. Different cameras and generators use different transfer functions. Mismatched transfer functions between face and background reveal content from different imaging pipelines.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante video luma range analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
